action.description: Which action to take. Default log; other options include issue.

ignoreFiles.description: List of file names to ignore. Binary artifacts with these names are allowed. File name only, not a path. Globs are not allowed.

action.description: Override for org-level action when present.

ignorePaths.description: List of full paths to ignore. If a binary artifact is reported at these paths, it is ignored. Must be full paths with directories. Globs are not allowed. Allowed even if repo override is disabled.

OrgOptConfig.description: OptConfig contains the opt in/out configuration.

DisableRepoOverride.description: DisableRepoOverride : set to true to disallow repos from opt-in/out in their config.

OptOutForkedRepos.description: OptOutForkedRepos : set to true to opt-out forked repositories.

OptOutArchivedRepos.description: OptOutArchivedRepos : set to true to opt-out archived repositories.

OptOutPublicRepos.description: OptOutPublicRepos : set to true to not access public repos.

OptOutPrivateRepos.description: OptOutPrivateRepos : set to true to not access private repos.

OptOutRepos.description: OptOutRepos is the list of repos to opt-out when in opt-out strategy.

OptInRepos.description: OptInRepos is the list of repos to opt-in when in opt-in strategy.

OptOutStrategy.description: OptOutStrategy : set to true to change from opt-in to opt-out.

optIn.description: Opt in this repository when the organization uses opt-in strategy.

optOut.description: Opt out this repository when the organization uses opt-out strategy.

BaseConfig.description: The GitHub owner/repository containing the base configuration. The file at the same path is merged first, then values in this file override it. See https://github.com/ossf/allstar#org-level-base-and-merge-configuration-location.
